about: The email builder's lint limits and word lists. scripts/email_draft_plan.py reads this file, so change a rule here and nowhere else. Each key is explained under notes. A lint blocker makes the plan's change blocked; a warning is shown with the plan.

notes.subject_max_chars: A subject longer than this (Jinja counted at jinja_estimate_chars each) is a warning: desktop inboxes cut it off around here. Same value as campaign-qa.
notes.subject_blocker_chars: A subject longer than this is a blocker: it is cut off everywhere and reads as spam.
notes.preheader_max_chars: A preheader longer than this is a warning: inboxes show only the start. Same value as campaign-qa.
notes.jinja_estimate_chars: Characters assumed for each {{ ... }} expression when measuring the subject and preheader before rendering. Same value as campaign-qa.
notes.email_size_warning_kb: HTML at or above this many KB is a warning: Gmail clips it, which can hide the unsubscribe link. Same value as campaign-qa.
notes.tracking_pixel_max_px: An image whose width or height attribute is at most this many pixels, or that is hidden with display:none, counts as a tracking pixel: a blocker unless its host is one the user supplied.
notes.known_asset_hosts: Image and stylesheet hosts always allowed (the Bloomreach Engagement media library). Any other host must be listed in the draft's user_supplied_hosts, or the image is a blocker. Subdomains match.
notes.placeholder_hosts: Link and image hosts that are never a real destination: a blocker.
notes.placeholder_patterns: Regular expressions (case-insensitive) for unfinished copy: lorem ipsum, TODO, empty {{ }}, the starter template's %%SLOT%% markers, merge tags from other tools and engine-ID placeholders. A match in the name, subject, preheader or HTML is a blocker.
notes.unsubscribe_tokens: Jinja names that make a working unsubscribe link. The HTML needs an href containing one of them, or the plan is blocked.
notes.address_variable_words: A {{ project_variables.<name> }} whose name contains one of these words counts as the postal address. Otherwise the draft's postal_address text must appear in the HTML.
notes.banned_jinja: Text that doesn't work in Bloomreach Jinja (see engagement-jinja-writer): a blocker.
notes.schedule: The schedule every draft is created with. create_email_campaign requires one; {"type": "now"} sets no send time, and the person who starts the campaign in the Engagement UI sets the real time first.
